report:
Support for Schema Update in Debezium Oracle Connector

Hi Team,
We have a Debezium Oracle Connector setup in our confluent cloud which is running fine and populating the data in the kafka stream, initially we were doing POC and set the decimal.handling.mode = 'string', and it created the schema WRT to the config.
Now we want the columns to properly map the NUMBER column in the right way hence we change the decimal.handling.mode = "precise"
Steps we followed:
1.We paused the connector
2. deleted all the schema for all the topics for both value and key
3. set the decimal.handling.mode = "precise"
4.started the connector.
ISSUE: the connector after starting is creating a new version of the schema only for few of the topics (having messages already), but some topics schema is still not getting created.
I can digest this issue for some topic as there is no message in them and if CDC kicks in the schema may get created (I am assuming this)
, but some topics in which there are already message for them as well the schema is not getting created.
Is there anything I am missing, please help with the same.
Regards,
Vivek Kumar
Thanks in Advance.
Vivek Kumar

evidence.quote: you will only see new schemas created in the schema registry as the table's have new changes observed"; reporter: "I was also assuming the same

notes: After deleting registry schemas and changing decimal.handling.mode, schemas only reappear when events are emitted; intended behavior.
